+## I41 independent audit, technical profile comparison and remaining density gap
+
+The [completed I41 report](iterations/i41-rademacher-fair-start-warming.md) independently audits I40’s Gaussian relaxation G, sufficient criterion C, stationary four-time identity and entropy-spike obstruction: **PASS ORIGINAL WITHOUT REPAIRS**. Gaussian G remains a technical consequence of accepted source operations. I41 additionally gives an author proof of the Rademacher positive-profile comparison R on every compact rectangle of positive waiting and lag times, jointly with the stationary autocorrelation. This new proof awaits a fresh independent audit and does not enter the substantial count.
+
+The new comparison extends the source’s checked one/two-leg histories to three consecutive legs. It addresses conditional interiors, endpoint tests, the borderline derivative allocations, depth-uniform cutoff remainders, small endpoint mass, quenched cutoff removal and a polynomial time mesh. The parent checked the actual source’s averaged-history estimate, kernel recursion and conditional-interior contracts; their applicability throughout the extension remains an analytic review obligation. Exact finite diagnostics do not discharge it.
+
+For fair-start warming, I41 derives the positive identity D_J(s)=z_+ E_nu exp(-H(X_(2sT_n))) for the evolved density’s squared L2 norm. Its two-path collision representation has a midpoint tilted by the squared evolved density, and its normalized path law changes both the initial marginal and future intensities. The conjugated Feynman–Kac potential changes sign. Thus neither static replica comparison nor dropping the path weight proves a fixed-positive-time tight bound. The exponential initial annealed moment does not disprove positive-time quenched warming. The fair-start density estimate remains unpaid; it is a sufficient condition for W, not a necessary reformulation.
+
+A distinct entropy/Orlicz criterion is proved, with both its entropy and exponential-tail inputs left unproved for Rademacher SK. An explicit reversible product-refresh chain, started uniformly (and representable with independent fair bits), has bounded evolved entropy and vanishing stationary observable moments of every fixed order, yet a late-time expectation bump. Its exponential norm does not vanish. This refutes the generic entropy shortcut; it is neither an SK counterexample nor a claim about an SK autocorrelation observable.
+
+The parent read the report and verifier and reproduced [both commands](experiments/i41-parent-verification.json). Checks pass for 238 sealed artifacts, 174 frozen inputs, 74 selected pinned files in five manuscripts, 22 read records, 46 source contracts, seventeen successful fresh responses including seven pinned files and five versioned PDFs, and all 9,340 corpus files against the complete 749-manuscript inventory. All 258 I39 and 237 I40 sealed artifacts remain unchanged. The 2,846 new exact assertions and 3,285 plus 389 replayed checks pass, with no floating diagnostics or pre-integration input drift. This is evidence reproduction, separate from analytic proof review.
+
+[I42’s fresh independent audit](iterations/iteration42-four-time-profile-r2-task.json) checks the new partial results and their exact limitations. The difficult fair-start density target is parked pending a new mechanism; full two-law W remains **unproved and not refuted**. [I43’s fresh discovery lane](iterations/iteration43-convex-isoperimetric-discovery-task.json) screens convex and isoperimetric questions, excluding equality-plus-standard-stability transfers and already counted Gaussian propeller consequences. Count remains **six of ten; four remaining**.
